stories.title: 10-Year Treasury Yield Hits Highest Level in Nearly Two Decades
stories.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield has climbed to its highest level in almost 20 years, CNBC reports. The rise pushes up long-term borrowing costs across the economy. CNBC's report traces the path that led to this level.
stories.whyItMatters: Higher long-term yields raise costs for mortgages and corporate debt, and they reset how investors value stocks.
whatToWatch: Whether the yield keeps rising or levels off
Fed commentary on rate policy
Effects on mortgage rates and stock valuations
questions: What is driving the yield higher: inflation expectations, deficits, or Fed policy?
How long can the climb continue before it pressures stocks?

sources.title: The 10-year Treasury yield is at its highest in nearly two decades. How we got here

stories.title: Trump Rolls Back Biden-Era Fuel Economy Standards
stories.summary: President Trump said he approved new fuel economy standards that ease Biden-era rules, CNBC and Investing.com report. The change loosens the fuel efficiency requirements automakers must meet. The reports do not detail the full scope of the rollback.
stories.whyItMatters: Automakers plan billions in investment around these rules, so a looser standard changes how much they spend on EVs versus gas engines.
whatToWatch: Formal publication of the new rule
Automaker reaction and any change to EV production plans
Possible legal challenges from states or environmental groups
questions: How much looser are the new standards than the Biden-era rules?
Will states such as California pursue their own separate standards?

stories.title: China Consumer Stocks Near Decade Lows as Money Flows Into AI
stories.summary: China consumer stocks are trading near their lowest levels in a decade, Investing.com reports. Investors are instead putting money into AI-related names. The split points to weak sentiment on China's consumer sector even as tech names draw interest.
stories.whyItMatters: The divergence signals investors doubt a near-term rebound in Chinese consumer spending, while AI enthusiasm keeps pulling in capital.
whatToWatch: Whether China consumer stocks find a floor
Continued flows into AI-linked names
Any policy move aimed at boosting consumer demand
questions: What would reverse the rotation out of consumer stocks?
Is the AI rally in China stocks sustainable?

stories.title: Muni Bond Yields Sit in a 'Sweet Spot,' MarketWatch Says
stories.summary: Tax-free municipal bond yields are in an attractive range right now, MarketWatch reports. The piece frames current yields as unusually favorable for tax-conscious investors. It suggests the window to get in may not last.
stories.whyItMatters: Municipal bonds offer tax-advantaged income, so elevated yields matter for investors managing fixed-income portfolios as rates shift.
whatToWatch: Whether muni yields hold or start to fall
Broader Treasury yield direction, which tends to pull munis along
questions: What is pushing muni yields into this range now?
How long is the window before yields compress?

stories.title: Horizon Kinetics Adds to Texas Pacific Land Stake
stories.summary: Horizon Kinetics bought additional shares of Texas Pacific Land (TPL), an insider filing reported by Investing.com shows. The reported purchase is small. The filing does not explain the firm's broader rationale.
stories.whyItMatters: Institutional buying in TPL, a closely watched land and royalty company, can signal how large holders view the stock.
whatToWatch: Any follow-on filings showing further buying or selling
TPL's next earnings or royalty income update
questions: Is this a routine addition or a signal of a larger position change?

stories.summary: Civista Bancshares president Charles Parcher bought $10,700 worth of company stock, an insider filing reported by Investing.com shows. The purchase is a modest, disclosed transaction. No further context on timing or motivation was given.
stories.whyItMatters: Insider buying can reflect executive confidence, though a purchase this size is small relative to typical insider stakes.
whatToWatch: Whether other Civista executives or directors make similar purchases
Civista's next quarterly results
questions: Does this purchase fit a pattern of recent insider buying at Civista?

stories.title: Five Years of Inflation, Charted: $6 Eggs to $50,000 Cars
stories.summary: A MarketWatch analysis charts how inflation has reshaped prices over the past five years, citing examples such as $6 eggs and $50,000 cars. The piece treats these price points as evidence of a broad, multi-year rise in the cost of living. It reviews how several categories of goods have been affected.
stories.whyItMatters: Five years of price increases at this scale shape household budgets, the Fed policy debate, and how investors think about real returns.
whatToWatch: Upcoming inflation data releases
Whether price growth in autos and groceries keeps moderating or reaccelerates
questions: Which categories are cooling fastest, and which stay sticky?

stories.title: Apple Hit With $5.7 Billion Patent Verdict Over Haptics
stories.summary: Apple faces a $5.7 billion patent infringement verdict tied to haptic feedback technology in the iPhone and Apple Watch, CNBC reports. The ruling covers Apple's use of haptics in these devices. The report does not detail Apple's next steps, including a possible appeal.
stories.whyItMatters: A verdict this size is a major legal and financial exposure for Apple, and it could affect how Apple licenses or redesigns haptic features.
whatToWatch: Whether Apple appeals the verdict
Any change to Apple's haptic technology in future products
Financial impact disclosed in Apple's next filings
questions: Will the verdict amount survive appeal?
Does this affect other manufacturers using similar haptic technology?

stories.title: A 10% Risk-Free Yield? For Some Investors, Yes.
stories.summary: MarketWatch reports that some investors can currently access a yield near 10% described as risk-free, though the piece limits this to specific situations rather than a broad market rate. The report gives limited detail on the exact instrument or who qualifies.
stories.whyItMatters: A yield that high, if genuinely low-risk, would be unusual against current Treasury rates and matters to income-focused investors.
whatToWatch: What instrument or account structure delivers this yield
Who qualifies and any limits on the amount
questions: What makes this yield 'risk-free,' and for whom is it actually available?

stories.title: Boeing Flags 737 Max Software Glitch in Automated Approach Functions
stories.summary: Boeing disclosed a software glitch affecting some automated approach functions on the 737 Max, CNBC reports. The issue involves certain automated flight functions used during approach. The report does not specify how many aircraft are affected or whether any grounding order followed.
stories.whyItMatters: Any issue tied to flight-critical software draws scrutiny given Boeing's history with the 737 Max, and it affects airline operations and regulators' response.
whatToWatch: FAA response or any directive tied to the glitch
Boeing's fix timeline and whether airlines adjust operations
Any effect on 737 Max delivery schedules
questions: How many aircraft or airlines are affected?
Does the glitch require a grounding or just a software patch?

stories.title: New Medicaid Work Rules Will Push Millions Off Coverage, Report Finds
stories.summary: Millions of people are expected to lose Medicaid coverage once new work requirements take effect, MarketWatch reports. The piece identifies certain groups as likely to be hit hardest, though it does not give exact numbers here. It frames the change as a major shift in program eligibility.
stories.whyItMatters: Large-scale Medicaid coverage losses affect consumer spending power and healthcare-sector revenue, both relevant to markets tracking consumer health.
whatToWatch: The effective date for the new work rules
State-by-state differences in implementation
Healthcare and insurer sector reaction
questions: Which groups are most exposed, and are there exemptions?
How will states verify compliance with the new rules?

stories.title: Nor'easter Floods US Northeast, Cancels More Than 400 Flights
stories.summary: A nor'easter brought flooding and power outages across the US Northeast, canceling more than 400 flights, Investing.com reports. The storm disrupted travel and utility service across the region. The report does not give a recovery timeline.
stories.whyItMatters: Weather disruption at this scale affects airline operations, insurance claims, and regional economic activity, with ripple effects into utility markets.
whatToWatch: Storm cleanup and power restoration timelines
Airline rebooking and any extended flight disruptions
Insured loss estimates as they emerge
questions: How long will power outages last?
Will flight disruptions extend into the following days?
